root_cause.text: Integer overflow in batadv_tvlv_container_list_size() due to using u16 for return type and accumulator, allowing the total container size to wrap around when exceeding U16_MAX, which then causes an undersized allocation in batadv_tvlv_container_ogm_append() and a heap buffer overflow.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "The return type and accumulator in batadv_tvlv_container_list_size() were u16. If the accumulated size exceeds U16_MAX, the value wraps around, causing the subsequent allocation ... to be undersized." The patch changes the return type from u16 to size_t and adds a check `if (tvlv_value_len > U16_MAX) { goto end; }`.

candidates.rationale: The return type u16 limits the sum of container sizes to values below 65535, causing integer wrap when total size exceeds U16_MAX.
The accumulator variable tvlv_len is declared as u16, which overflows when summing container sizes beyond 65535 bytes.
This variable stores the result of the vulnerable function; its u16 type propagates the wrapped value to the allocation call.
Assigns the potentially wrapped u16 result from batadv_tvlv_container_list_size to tvlv_value_len, carrying the overflow forward.
The variable tvlv_value_len, now containing a wrapped size, is used as the allocation length in batadv_tvlv_realloc_packet_buff, leading to an undersized buffer and heap overflow.
